extract_lsp_dataset: extract LSP dataset keypoints, centers, scales, and openpose detections into an npz file
build_lsp_training_data: build a training data npz file from LSP dataset joints and openpose keypoints
process_lsp_keypoints: process LSP dataset 14 keypoints into 24-part format with openpose detections
compute_lsp_bbox: compute bounding box, center, and scale from LSP dataset joint annotations
save_lsp_npz: save LSP dataset image names, centers, scales, parts, and openpose data to npz
